name: exoplan
description: Search, vet and explain transit candidates in public NASA TESS data from an AI assistant, over the exoplan-mcp stdio server: the exoplanet catalogue, stored runs with full provenance, BLS search and vetting, the limb-darkened transit fit, a bounded false-alarm probability, the Methods physics and the benchmarks. Every answer carries provenance and honesty labels; a candidate is never called a discovery. Requires exoplan-mcp on PATH (pip install -e '.[mcp]' in a SetuHQ checkout).
